_what: Where the Media screen reads its library, search and pictures (media-library-read.ts, media-search.ts, media-pictures.ts, media-playback.ts): the person's own files, as their files owner keeps them. Every SQL statement carries `statement_timeout_ms` (the run-sql tool's own limit). The library starts from the newest names (ns_name by modified time, a sequential read once), takes one page of `limit` media files, and joins only those files' longest kept second; `total` is its own bounded count. Read by `tool` with `credential_name`. `files_tool` is the files owner (tool:your-files) for thumbnails and byte ranges (read_file_span, `span_bytes` a window: 128 KiB, the door refuses a reply over about 1 MiB). `search` is the picture search: `embed_tool` and `embed_operation` turn the words into a picture-space vector (the kept tool, a few seconds), the nearest `pool` frames are read from media_index_vectors, and the best frame of each file is kept, the `results` best files shown.

raw_span._about: The raw byte path (media-raw-span.ts), used only when raw_spans is true: a tools/call of door_tool at route, its arguments {method, input} with input the read_file_span call and bytes {offset, length}, sent with Accept application/octet-stream; the answer is the span's raw body with X-Total-Bytes and X-Offset. Until the gateway passes the raw body through, raw_spans stays false and playback reads the JSON windows (span_bytes).
